## Objetivo
Integrate T05's stored plays with history, leaderboards, persisted suggestions and T13's server publisher. Own derived server reads and their invalidation contract, not transactional play feature delivery or client refetch/browser behavior.

## Critérios de Aceitação
- [ ] Seeded API tests assert global and per-game wins for sole winners, joint winners each receiving one win, missing scores, losers and zero-win members. Verify stable win/name/ID ordering and newest-first last-20 game history with stable ID tie-breaks for equal dates. Closing/reopening an isolated database retains identical results. Extend the authorization matrix to history/leaderboard endpoints. npm test covers these rules without client screens.
- [ ] Complete T04's concrete SQLite play-history adapter. API tests create confirmed nights and plays, proving suggestions exclude games from the two prior distinct confirmed nights only, retaining games from older/later/ad hoc plays. Multiple plays in one night count as one recent night. Reconfirmation does not rewrite existing plays or history. Assert persisted suggestion ordering and explanation text through the API.
- [ ] Using T13's helpers, a second authenticated HTTP/SSE session receives invalidation after committed ad hoc and night-linked plays. Subsequent canonical HTTP reads verify plays, history and global/per-game totals. A prior-night linked play invalidates affected later-night suggestions and their refetch excludes the newly played game. Broad invalidation is acceptable; cover every additional play mutation endpoint if introduced.
- [ ] An independent SQLite reader sees complete participant, score and winner records at publication. Invalid play requests, injected failure after partial inserts before commit and rejected deletion of a played game leave records/totals unchanged and publish no event. Assert publisher counts after request completion, without timed absence sleeps. npm test, npm run typecheck and npm run build pass. Client lifecycle and browser evidence belong to T15/T11.
